records.label: Asian-Inspired Chicken Salad

ingredients.raw: 1 package (6 oz) grilled chicken breast, cut in strips

ingredients.ingredient: review: ¾ cups salad dressing (teriyaki ginger, asian sesame with ginger, or balsamic vinaigrette)
ingredients.raw: ¾ cups salad dressing (teriyaki ginger, Asian sesame with ginger, or balsamic vinaigrette)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 mango, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced (optional)
ingredients.raw: 1 mango, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced (optional)

instructions: In large saucepan quickly plunge broccoli and pea pods into boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain vegetables. Quickly rinse with cold water. Drain well.
In large bowl toss together the blanched broccoli and pea pods, greens, cabbage and carrots.
Add chicken.
Drizzle with salad dressing. Toss to coat.
Arrange on 4 serving plates.
Top with mango, if desired.
Serve with crackers.

records.label: Ashoka Halwa (Mung Bean Pudding)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 cup split yellow moong dal

ingredients.raw: 1 pinch red food colouring in 1 teaspoon water

instructions: Dry roast the moong dal until it smells nutty and browns slightly.
Add 3 cups of water and pressure cook for about 7–8 whistles until the dal is soft and mushy.
Add 4 tablespoons ghee to a heavy-bottomed pot over medium-low heat, and cook the wheat flour in it until golden brown.
Stir the cooked dal into the flour mixture, and let it thicken for 5 minutes. Add the sugar.

Stirring continuously, start mixing in the remaining ghee 1 tablespoon at a time. Keep stirring until the mixture starts leaving the sides of the pan and the whole mixture forms a dough. It will take about 12–15 minutes and 6–7 tablespoons of ghee.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a separate frying pan, and add the cashews. Fry until slightly brown, then add to the halwa mixture.
Mix in the powdered cardamom and food color.
Remove from the heat and let cool.

records.label: Baked Beans

ingredients.ingredient: review: 2 pounds (900 g) navy, great northern, or pea beans, though black, kidney, or lima beans may be used for a different taste.
ingredients.raw: 2 pounds (900 g) Navy, Great Northern, or Pea beans, though black, kidney, or lima beans may be used for a different taste.

instructions: Soak dry beans overnight, or use 4 cans cooked beans.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Stir all ingredients together, then pour into casserole dish, bean pot or Dutch oven.
Add water from beans, or preferably stock or fresh water. Just enough to barely cover.  Canned beans may need less water.  Beans will absorb more water as they cook.
Bake 2½ hours. Check after an hour for moisture level, add more water as needed to keep appropriate moistness. If beans have too much liquid, remove lid and cook a bit longer.

records.label: Bean and Bacon Bake

ingredients.ingredient: review: 6 strips bacon, cooked until crisp, or microwave ready fully cooked bacon
ingredients.raw: 6 strips bacon, cooked until crisp, or microwave ready fully cooked bacon

ingredients.ingredient: review: ⅛ cup (15 g / 0.53 oz) sliced almonds
ingredients.raw: ⅛ cup (15 g / 0.53 oz) sliced almonds

instructions: Peel and dice the potato.
Crumble crisp bacon into small pieces.
Drain green beans, keeping ½ cup of the liquid.
Put beans, bean juice, bacon, and potato in a microwave-safe baking dish.
Sprinkle onion powder and salt on top.
Cover with clear wrap.
Cook in microwave oven 5 minutes, stir, and cook another 5 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Garnish with sliced almonds.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Champ (Irish Mashed Potato with Scallion)

instructions: Boil potatoes in water until done.
Drain the potatoes and mash them.
Pour the milk into a saucepan, add the chopped scallions and cook vigorously.
When cooked, sieve the scallions and set the milk aside.
Add the scallions to the potatoes and mix well.
Add as much of the scallion-infused milk as possible to make a ‘wet’ soft mixture.
Season with freshly ground pepper and salt.
Serve with a central well filled with melted butter.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Chukauni (Nepalese Potato Salad)

ingredients.raw: 4 boiled potatoes, peeled and roughly cubed

instructions: Put the boiled potatoes in a bowl.
Add chopped chilies and chilies.
Pour the yoghurt over the potatoes.
Add salt and red chili powder as per your taste.
In a small wok or pan, heat some oil with red chilies and fenugreek seed.
When the seeds turn black, remove the pan from heat.
Add turmeric powder over the oil immediately.
Pour the oil over the potatoes and yoghurt mixture.
Mix the mixture evenly with a ladle or a spoon.

records.label: Chuu Chee Fish

ingredients.ingredient: review: 650 g whole bream or similar fish
ingredients.raw: 650 g whole bream or similar fish
1 metric cup vegetable oil (reserve 1 tablespoon for stir-frying curry paste)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 teaspoon of kaeng chu chee curry paste
ingredients.raw: 1 teaspoon of kaeng chu chee curry paste

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 tablespoon (warning: perhaps the metric 20 ml one) fish sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 tablespoon (warning: perhaps the metric 20 mL one) fish sauce

instructions: In a wok or large frypan, over high heat, fry fish using most of the vegetable oil, until golden on one side. It will take about 5 minutes.
Lower heat and, using tongs, gently turn fish over.
Turn up heat again and cook until golden. Using tongs again, lift fish gently onto a serving plate.
In the wok, gently stir-fry the curry-paste and lime leaves in remaining tablespoon of oil.
Add coconut milk and fish sauce. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Add sugar and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Taste to see if extra coconut milk, fish sauce, or sugar is required.
Pour sauce over fish and garnish with cilantro and chopped chili peppers.

records.label: Corn Bread Fish

ingredients.ingredient: review: 4 boneless, skinless fish fillets (about 6 ounces each, 1–1¼ inches at thickest), such as tilapia, catfish or trout (see notes)
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless, skinless fish fillets (about 6 ounces each, 1–1¼ inches at thickest), such as tilapia, catfish or trout (see notes)

ingredients.ingredient: review: ⅓ cup bottled italian dressing
review: 1 large corn muffin, or ⅔ cup coarse crumbs
ingredients.raw: 1 large corn muffin, or ⅔ cup coarse crumbs

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 lemon, or 3 tablespoons lemon juice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (204°C).
Spray a glass baking dish with cooking-oil spray.
Season each fish piece with salt and pepper, and place in the dish.
Pour the dressing evenly over the fish.
Crumble the corn muffin, and sprinkle the crumbs over the fish.

Place the dish in the preheated oven, and bake until the dressing is bubbling at the edges, the crumbs lightly brown, and the thickest part of the fillets are opaque and flake easily with a fork (about 15 to 20 minutes).
While fish is baking, cut the lemon into 4 parts and set aside.
When the fish is done, remove it from the oven, squeeze the juice from the lemon quarters over the fish, and serve immediately.

records.label: Fish and Chips

ingredients.raw: Enough cold water to form a batter

ingredients.ingredient: review: 4 cod/haddock/monkfish (or any other suitable flaky fish) fillets
ingredients.raw: 4 cod/haddock/monkfish (or any other suitable flaky fish) fillets
1 litre (1¾ pint) vegetable oil for deep-frying

ingredients.ingredient: review: sprig of parsley, to garnish

instructions: Preheat the vegetable oil in a deep fryer to 180°C (350°F), or until a cube of bread browns in 15 seconds when added to the oil.
Peel the potatoes and cut into thick wedges. Deep-fry the potatoes in batches for 6–8 minutes or until they are crisp and golden.
Remove from the oil, and drain on kitchen paper. Sprinkle with sea salt and keep warm.
In a bowl, whisk together the plain flour, corn flour, salt, and enough cold water to form a batter.
Cut the fish into thick slices, then coat in the batter.
Deep fry the fish in batches for 5–6 minutes, depending on the size of the fish. Remove and drain on kitchen paper.
Transfer the fish and chips to serving plates and garnish with lemon wedges and sprig of parsley. Or for a fun, traditional twist, place the fried fish and chips on brown paper or newsprint.

Top with salt and/or vinegar. Typically the lemon wedges are squeezed over the fish and the vinegar is sprinkled on the chips. Also can be served with pickles, pickled onions, tartar sauce, pickled eggs, and mushy peas.

records.label: Chipotle BBQ Salmon Burgers

ingredients.raw: 1¼ pounds skinless wild salmon filet, cut into 2-inch cubes

ingredients.ingredient: review: seafood seasoning, such as old bay
ingredients.raw: Seafood seasoning, such as Old Bay

ingredients.ingredient: review: 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
ingredients.raw: 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted

ingredients.ingredient: review: 3 chipotles in adobo sauce, finely minced
ingredients.raw: 3 chipotles in adobo sauce, finely minced
3 tbsp unsalted butter, cut into small cubes

instructions: Run salmon cubes through a meat grinder on medium setting. Mix with chipotle, sauce, butter, and adobo.
Form into 4 equal patties, about ¾ inch thick. Brush with extra-virgin olive oil and season both sides liberally with seasoning. Set aside.
Preheat grill pan to medium high. Rub with olive oil, then add salmon patties. Grill 5–6 minutes per side for medium rare, or until desired doneness is achieved.
Brush buns with oil. Place a patty on and close. Serve immediately with desired condiments.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Honey-Peppered Salmon

instructions: In a shallow dish, combine oil, honey, mustard, garlic, cayenne, coriander, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
Add salmon and let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Grease a baking dish.
Remove salmon from marinade and place in the prepared dish.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until desired "doneness".

records.label: Maple Syrup Planked Salmon

ingredients.ingredient: review: 4 salmon steaks or individual fillets (preferably wild-caught)
ingredients.raw: 4 salmon steaks or individual fillets (preferably wild-caught)
4 tbsp (60 ml) fresh lemon juice, divided

ingredients.ingredient: review: 2 tsp (10 ml) pure maple syrup
review: 2 tbsp (30 ml) grapeseed oil (or other neutral oil)
ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp (30 ml) grapeseed oil (or other neutral oil)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1½ tsp (7 g) chipotle powder (chipotle barbecue sauce may be substituted for this)
ingredients.raw: 1½ tsp (7 g) chipotle powder (chipotle barbecue sauce may be substituted for this)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 tsp (5 g) crushed dried rosemary
review: 2 scallions, thinly sliced for garnish

instructions: Completely immerse cedar planks in water for several hours or overnight.
Heat grill to medium-high.

Mix 2 tablespoons (30 ml) lemon juice, the oil, rosemary, maple syrup, and half of the chipotle powder in a small bowl. Coat the salmon with the mixture and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Mix the remaining lemon juice with the remaining chipotle powder with a fork and set aside as a garnish.
Place plank(s) on grill and close lid. Allow plank to heat for a couple minutes.
Lightly sprinkle salt on plank(s).
Put salmon on plank, keeping fish at least an inch from the edge of the plank (in the case of fillets, place skin-side down). Reduce heat to low and close lid.

Grill for roughly 15 minutes without turning or moving salmon until desired "doneness" is reached. Generally, salmon should be cooked until the flesh loses its transparency and the meat can easily be broken with a fork. Spray with water to douse any flames that light on the sides of the plank.
When cooked, place the salmon on a serving platter and sprinkle with the scallions.
Immerse the cedar plank in water as a safety precaution.
Serve the salmon with the optional lemon juice/chipotle sauce.

records.label: Beef Stew II

ingredients.raw: 500 g (1 lb) beef suitable for soup/stew, cut into cubes and trimmed of fat and gristle
100–125 g (approx. ¼ lb) frozen carrots, sliced

ingredients.ingredient: review: 100–125 g (approx. ¼ lb) frozen mushrooms, sliced
ingredients.raw: 100–125 g (approx. ¼ lb) frozen mushrooms, sliced

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 large or 2 small bay leaves

instructions: Mix the flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder together in a small bowl.
Heat a large saucepan on the stovetop, then add olive oil and chopped onion.
Dredge the beef cubes in the flour mixture and drop them into the saucepan; reserve the remaining flour mixture. Brown the beef on all sides.
Pour in the broth and add the remaining flour mixture, the potatoes, carrots, mushrooms, tomatoes, marjoram and bay leaf/leaves.
Once it has come to a boil, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover, and simmer for an hour or more, until the beef and potatoes are tender.

records.label: Booyah (Chicken Vegetable Stew)

ingredients.raw: 2 cups tomato sauce (or 1 quart whole tomatoes)

instructions: Place chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Simmer until chicken is well done.
Remove chicken from broth and skim off fat.
Add remaining ingredients to broth.
Remove chicken meat from bones and skin. Cut meat into small pieces and add to broth. Add salt and water to taste.
Cover and let simmer for at least 3 hours. It tastes best when cooked all day.

records.label: Callaloo (Caribbean Stewed Greens)

ingredients.ingredient: review: ¼ pound salted beef or salted pork (optional)
ingredients.raw: ¼ pound salted beef or salted pork (optional)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 2 crabs, cleaned and broken in pieces
ingredients.raw: 2 crabs, cleaned and broken in pieces

instructions: Strip the stalks and midribs from the taro leaves.
Wash and cut leaves and soft stalks, discarding remainder.
Soak salted beef or salted pork, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Cut okra, chives and thyme into small pieces.
In a large pot combine callaloo leaves, salted meat, okra, chive, thyme, onion, garlic, crab, coconut milk, and water.
Bring to the boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes or more until everything is soft and cooked.
Swizzle or beat with a hand beater.
Add butter and stir well.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Egyptian Lentil Stew

ingredients.ingredient: review: salt to taste or 4 tablespoons of soup mix (you can use any kind of soup mix, or if you don't have any, you can just leave it out)
ingredients.raw: Salt to taste or 4 tablespoons of soup mix (you can use any kind of soup mix, or if you don't have any, you can just leave it out)

instructions: Place the chopped onions into the big pot, along with the 4 tablespoons of olive oil.
Sauté the onions on low heat until they turn translucent and slightly golden.
Add the 8 cups of water, lentils, soup mix, cumin, and coriander to the pot with the onions.
Stir, then turn up the temperature of the stove to about medium heat (you want it to be slightly bubbling, but not boiling).
Let it simmer for an hour, stirring every few minutes to make sure that it doesn't burn. You may have to turn the temperature of the stove up or down a little. Taste, and add salt if needed.
Turn off the stove and put the pot on a different burner so that it doesn't continue to cook.
Take your lemon, and cut it in half. Then, squeeze it on the juicer until there is no more juice in the lemon.
Stir the lemon juice into the pot.
Taste the soup, and serve! Cumin and more fresh lemon and can be added to the bowl according to preference.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Khichdi (South Asian Rice and Lentils)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 teacup dal (e.g. moong dhal, arhar dal or masoor dal or combination thereof)
ingredients.raw: 1 teacup dal (e.g. moong dhal, arhar dal or masoor dal or combination thereof)

instructions: Wash rice and lentils and soak them for 10–15 minutes in water.
Add salt and turmeric powder.
Pressure cook with 3–4 cups of water.
After the first whistle, reduce the heat and cook for 4–5 more minutes.
Allow to cool. Serve with ghee or buttermilk.

records.label: Beef Yakiniku Pizza

ingredients.ingredient: review: ½ red capsicum, cut into 10 pieces
ingredients.raw: ½ red capsicum, cut into 10 pieces
600 g tenderloin beef, cut into 2 x 1 x 1 cm pieces
2 tbsp cornstarch, dissolved with 20 ml water

instructions: Combine flours, yeast, sugar, water, and salt to make a dough.
Cover with plastic wrap, and rest the dough 10 minutes until expanded.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the onion and capsicum, and sauté for 10 seconds.
Add the tenderloin and the water. Add the mirin, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Add the dissolved cornflour, salt, and sugar. Stir until well-mixed and slightly thickened.
Separate the solids from the extra sauce. Reserve the sauce to serve with the pizza.
Roll out the pizza dough to a 10 cm diameter. Spread the meat topping on top.
Bake pizza in the oven at 220°C for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with the dipping sauces.

records.attribution: Wikibooks contributors. Dataset by Gosse Minnema (July 2024). Adapted for offmenu; original ingredient text retained.

records.label: Chicken Alfredo Pizza

ingredients.ingredient: review: pizza dough (e.g. basic pizza crust or a pre-packaged dough for convenience)
ingredients.raw: Pizza dough (e.g. Basic Pizza Crust or a pre-packaged dough for convenience)

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 large jar of alfredo sauce

ingredients.raw: 1 large package of shredded cheese (e.g. cheddar, mozzarella)

instructions: Cut up the chicken breast, and sear/bake/grill it until it is cooked through.
Prepare the pizza crust and spread it on a medium-sized pizza pan.
Spread some Alfredo sauce on the crust, and top with cooked chicken. Repeat to make a few layers, then sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Bake in oven at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes or until the crust is done.

records.label: Four in One Pizza

ingredients.raw: ½ cup (2 ounces) shredded cheddar cheese
½ cup BBQ sauce mixed with shredded chicken

ingredients.ingredient: review: 1 tablespoon thin strips of fresh basil
ingredients.raw: 1 tablespoon thin strips of fresh basil

ingredients.ingredient: review: 2 slices canadian bacon, cut in quarters
ingredients.raw: 2 slices Canadian bacon, cut in quarters

ingredients.ingredient: review: ¼ cup drained chopped pineapple

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.
Sprinkle lightly with cornmeal, if desired.
Unroll pizza dough and press out on cookie sheet into a 12 x 14-inch shape.
Brush dough with olive oil.
Bake crust for 6–8 minutes.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the crust in a cross shape to divide crust in fourths.
In each corner, spread one of the above toppings (or one of your own!).
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the top of all.
Bake another 10–14 minutes, until cheese is bubbly but not burned.
Cut each corner into 4 squares.
